nonBlockingObservations.title: Scope overview still names the previous base
nonBlockingObservations.description: The overview names product 0985273 and inventory v222, whereas the request, manifest, source.json, product-map.json and recorded lane bind product 01769e93db878836612d9e3d483a054f7ad1da94 and inventory v223. The actual candidate and pins agree with the latter, so this does not block acceptance. Correct the overview in a subsequent documentation subject.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Depth boundary witness is not a valid TS2 frame
nonBlockingObservations.description: The test correctly recomputes the schema-derived bounds and demonstrates that the CBOR reader accepts seven nested containers and refuses eight. Its positive witness is an array nested around null, rather than a schema-valid TS2 envelope and payload as its comment and SCOPE claim. Add a valid maximum-depth TS2 frame witness when strengthening this control. The independent schema traversal and existing lawful-session coverage make this non-blocking.
